en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small riverside town set in a heavily forested, hilly landscape. In the foreground are several large wooden houses among mature trees. A suspension bridge with tall towers spans the river to the right, connecting wooded banks and a compact town center with low commercial buildings and church spires. In the far background a solitary conical hill or small mountain rises above the tree line. The lower border of the image shows faint handwritten numbers, suggesting a catalog or negative reference rather than a title.
